title: Implement all 14 UI primitives in Phase 6
essence: Build the whole design-system primitive layer in Phase 6 because every downstream surface depends on it; deferral bottlenecks Phase 7.

title: Split Compass into ROM router + UI component
essence: Separate stateless decision-logic router (ROM, API-only) from presentation UI so the router can be tested, versioned, and reimplemented independently.

title: Python-first runtime, defer Go to hot-path later
essence: Choose Python for the operator/canon layer (prose-heavy, iterative); extract hot paths to Go only if profiling later shows a bottleneck.

title: Court vetoes VCE v2.0 in Phase 6 to protect Hila gate
essence: Constitutional Court defers VCE v2.0: a high-irreversibility deadline (Hila gate) was disguised as low-irreversibility 'be thorough' work.

title: Define satoshi = smallest recursively buildable coherence unit
essence: A satoshi is the quantum of coherence: on_purpose=true, nci>=50, irreversibility<=0.5, all DNA axioms checked; satoshis compose recursively.

title: Receipt-core before Prep Guide UI (Court veto)
essence: Receipts are the product substrate; UI without persistence is lore not nonfiction, so build receipt-core/persistence first even though it is invisible.

title: Migrate SQLite→Postgres only at scale thresholds
essence: Stay on SQLite until >10K daily receipts, multi-region, or <100ms query latency required; migration is low-irreversibility so defer the ops burden.

title: Operator-20 seeds in Phase 6, cultivation deferred
essence: Define folksonomy seed vectors in Phase 6 (a design decision) but defer DBSCAN cultivation until >50-receipt corpus exists; trigger manually.

title: Kintsugi independent of Constitutional Court
essence: Court is prevention (pre-decision), Kintsugi is repair (post-hoc); decouple them so one bug can't cascade and Kintsugi can audit offline.

title: Phase 7 = receipt-infra-first, defer productization to Phase 8
essence: Court vetoes full Auth/Prisma/Stripe productization in Phase 7; receipt infrastructure IS the product, productization is Phase 8. Logs NGI failure-class.

title: Gold-receipt criteria
essence: A gold receipt is on-purpose not lucky (reasoning documented), reversible (low irreversibility), lived (has an outcome/delta/lesson), and canonical (schema-aligned).

title: High-irreversibility disguised as low → Court veto
essence: Constitutional motion-rule recurring across receipts: when a naive completionist path hides a ruin-level irreversibility, Court must STOP and defer.

title: Receipts are the ROM substrate
essence: Motion-rule: any surface without receipt persistence is lore, not nonfiction; logging a decision_receipt_id is non-negotiable, sequenced before UI.

title: Six enforced architectural principles
essence: Traceable, Transparent, Explainable, Composable, Anti-hallucination, Anti-sycophancy — each bound to a concrete mechanism; violating one is a design bug not a style choice.

title: Git non-fast-forward rejection IS the write-lock
essence: Git serializes total order for tracked files (non-ff rejection = write-lock); out-of-band surfaces have no lock — the serialized-vs-advisory gap is the central hazard.

title: Dormancy is a state, not staleness
essence: A seed unmatched for months is dormant not dead; never garbage-collect it, zero ripe seeds is healthy winter — throwaway context, not throwaway learning.

title: harvest→seed cycle compounds the bank
essence: Seven-verb botanical lifecycle (seed/plant/water/germinate/sprout/grow/harvest); harvest mints new seeds from matured output so the bank compounds, not merely accumulates.

title: Coal→diamond session compaction seed
essence: Compact a high-entropy session into a dense durable seed (manifest+belief-log+handoff with head/tail); the portable value is the machinery, not the deliverable.

title: Bet-ledger not diary; conviction rises as risk retires
essence: The belief-log's real output is the isotopic signature of how conviction formed and moved; confidence climbing while risk stays flat is unearned optimism, flagged.

title: Drift-check is mechanical, no judgment
essence: Anti-hallucination via mechanism: drift-check says STALE by definition (no judgment), evidence[] demands provenance, gates halt never decide (NOTOMATION).

title: API flakiness is siloed knowledge, not bad luck
essence: Register the integration contract as a canonical surface; drift-check flags when a branch's projection (GET/POST/error-path) goes stale before it ships as intermittent failure.

title: Kairos timing layer — forced dated move/wait read
essence: Timing (is-now-golden) is separate from desirability (high-EV); Kairos forces move-now-vs-wait and names the re-check date so 'wait' is scheduled return, never drift.

title: The firm bill frees the kitchen
essence: ARCS is the anchor to radical free thinking: a deliberately firm deterministic detector frees the operator's timing sense — Kairos is the rice, not the meal.

title: Color is grammar, not decoration
essence: The one design law: color IS meaning (NCI grade ramp + Y-weather), never render more certainty than the data deserves (earned fidelity), liquid-glass never flat.

title: ARCS is a processor, not a controller
essence: Enforced-in-code invariant: no key custody, no sensitive read/write, engines are pure functions holding no state or secrets; BYO creds arrive per-request and are discarded.

title: One shape: input→operator lens→Receipt(gold)
essence: Every mini-app is identical: raw input → one operator lens → a Receipt → share/pay; a new bet is one new pure engine reusing everything, half a day not a sprint.

title: Don't grade your own homework — verifiers are foreign
essence: Governance motion-rule: a lord rules its output, advisors counsel but never rule, verifying advisors come from OTHER prefectures; a control it also polices is captured.

title: Missing signals are neutral, never punitive
essence: Wide aperture by default: absent signals score 0 (neutral) not penalized; confidence communicates data completeness separately from fit score.

title: Deterministic CSV-driven now, embeddings when receipts accumulate
essence: POC must be offline, explainable, reversible; deterministic csv features keep diffs/audits simple — bolt on embeddings/learned weights only once decision receipts accumulate.

title: Cap title adjacency to one match per role
essence: Title adjacency was previously unbounded; cap to a single match per role to avoid overweighting repeated synonyms.

title: Taxonomies as plain CSVs evolve without code
essence: Progressive enhancement: skills taxonomy and canonical adjacency live as plain CSVs so the knowledge layer can evolve without code changes; new columns stay optional.

title: Energy alignment outweighs credentials
essence: Career-fit weights energy_alignment highest (0.30), prioritizing zone-of-genius/resonance over education and company pedigree; drainer flags penalize the score.

title: Objections = destructive interference (PhaseCancel)
essence: Identify objections as destructive-interference patterns and attach a mitigation (phase correction) to each; sort by severity — operationalizes the PhaseCancel primitive.

title: Adjust the smallest lever first
essence: Navigate career phase-space by adjusting smallest levers first: title BFQ → company tier → market → geo; nearest-neighbor discovery orders moves by cost.

title: Same inputs + seed → same outputs
essence: Reproducibility is a first-class requirement: same inputs (with seed) produce same outputs for auditable, defensible decision-making.

title: Label inferred bias with confidence intervals
essence: All hiring-bias analysis must be clearly labeled 'inferred from public team-composition patterns' and carry confidence intervals — disclosure gate against overclaiming.

title: Skills are open, animating priors stay private
essence: Marketplace posture: each plugin points at a canonical upstream repo (single source of truth); the skills are open-source, the animating priors stay private.
